definition: to cause something to move by pulling
description: A young man in yellow waterproof dungarees stands in a small blue and orange wooden fishing boat on open sea below green cliffs. He leans right back with both hands on a fishing rod that is bent almost double, dragging the line up out of the water until a large silver fish breaks the surface on the hook and swings over the side of the boat. He then works a round landing net, hauling it up out of the water and swinging it in over a wooden crate on the deck, where several silver fish are already lying. At the end he lifts the full crate up towards the camera with both hands and grins.

taps.phrase: to lift a box of fish
